content.title: Welcome to Genie—let's boost your energy
content.body: You told us you want more energy, and we heard you. Energy isn't random—it's driven by things we can actually measure and improve: your blood work, sleep patterns, activity, and nutrition. Over the next few weeks, we'll help you find what's draining you and what can fuel you better. Ready to get started?

content.title: Iron deficiency might be why you're tired
content.body: You need 18mg of iron daily—nearly double what men need—to prevent anemia and fatigue. Yet 1 in 5 young Singaporean women are iron-deficient. Add iron-rich foods like spinach, lentils, or lean meat to your meals, and pair them with vitamin C for better absorption.
content.footer: Source: Health Promotion Board Dietary Guidelines 2023

content.title: Upload your lab report to see what's draining your energy
content.body: Your blood work can reveal hidden causes of fatigue—low iron, thyroid issues, vitamin D deficiency. Upload any recent health screening or blood test results (last 6 months). Takes 2 minutes using your phone camera.

content.title: Your sleep tonight affects your energy tomorrow
content.body: Getting less than 7 hours of sleep increases your anxiety risk by 2.5 times. Your brain consolidates memories and regulates emotions during deep sleep—skimp on it, and you're setting yourself up for next-day stress. Aim to be in bed by 11pm tonight.
content.footer: Source: Singapore Mental Health Study 2016, Institute of Mental Health
